event: Broadcom Q3 FY2026 earnings call
supports_if: AI semiconductor revenue meets or exceeds the ~$16 billion guide and the committed backlog continues growing
weakens_if: Revenue misses guidance or backlog growth stalls

event: TSMC Q3 2026 earnings call
supports_if: Management reiterates that CoWoS capacity is fully booked and maintains or raises 2026/2027 capacity and capex targets
weakens_if: Management signals CoWoS capacity easing or capital-expenditure guidance is cut

event: OpenAI custom-ASIC shipment milestone
supports_if: Shipment continues to slip and any delay is explicitly tied to packaging or capacity constraints
weakens_if: OpenAI's custom ASIC ships on the revised schedule with no packaging-related delay cited
source_to_monitor: OpenAI and Broadcom public statements, trade press

event: Hyperscaler Q3 2026 capital-expenditure guidance (Google, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon)
supports_if: Capex guidance continues to grow, sustaining demand pressure on packaging capacity
weakens_if: Capex guidance decelerates or is cut

event: Execution of definitive agreements for Nvidia's six AI compute-infrastructure financing platforms
supports_if: Agreements are signed with terms showing Nvidia guarantees, equity stakes, or other circular linkages to borrowing counterparties
weakens_if: Agreements are signed with fully arm's-length, diversified, transparent terms with no Nvidia guarantee exposure
source_to_monitor: NVIDIA Newsroom (nvidianews.nvidia.com) and partner-firm investor communications (Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, KKR)

event: Nvidia quarterly earnings calls and SEC filings disclosing guarantee and financing-commitment exposure
supports_if: Nvidia discloses growing guarantee, financing, or equity-stake commitments to AI-lab and hyperscaler customers
weakens_if: Nvidia discloses shrinking or capped financing-related exposure, or clarifies prior reported figures were overstated

event: Next Bank for International Settlements or IMF financial-stability commentary on AI-related credit risk
expected_window: Q4 2026 (BIS quarterly review) / October 2026 (IMF Global Financial Stability Report)
supports_if: BIS or IMF reiterate or escalate warnings about AI circular financing and hyperscaler debt
weakens_if: BIS or IMF assess AI financing risk as contained or improving

event: Continued movement in Nvidia and major hyperscaler credit default swap and bond spreads
supports_if: Spreads remain elevated or widen further
weakens_if: Spreads normalize toward pre-2026 levels
source_to_monitor: Credit market data and financial press coverage of CDS/bond spreads

event: First large-scale secondary-market resale or retirement of 3+ year old frontier AI GPU clusters
supports_if: Resale values come in materially below industry retention estimates, consistent with the depreciation bear case
weakens_if: Resale values meet or exceed industry retention estimates
source_to_monitor: Secondary GPU marketplace data and industry analyst reports

event: Ajinomoto's next investor disclosures / earnings commentary on its Electronic Materials (ABF) business segment
expected_window: around November 2026 (Ajinomoto's fiscal H1, April-September 2026, results)
supports_if: Ajinomoto confirms the Q3 2026 price increase took effect, reiterates its ABF capacity timeline (including the reported 2032 new-plant target), and reports continued strong ABF demand/pricing
weakens_if: Ajinomoto reports the price increase was scaled back, delayed, or that new capacity is being accelerated materially ahead of 2032

event: Ibiden's fiscal Q2 FY2026 results (period ending September 2026)
supports_if: Ibiden reiterates that AI-server IC substrate demand continues to exceed capacity and confirms its capex plan and Gama/Ono plant timeline are on track
weakens_if: Ibiden reports demand softening relative to capacity, or delays/scales back its FY2026-2028 capital investment plan

event: Unimicron's Q3 2026 earnings call
supports_if: AI/HPC share of ABF substrate revenue continues rising toward or beyond the ~70% H2 2026 projection and utilization/margin trends show continued capacity constraint
weakens_if: Gross margin recovers sharply or AI/HPC revenue share plateaus, suggesting the substrate shortage is easing faster than expected

event: TSMC's Q3 2026 earnings call: memory/ABF substrate bottleneck commentary
supports_if: TSMC management reiterates or escalates memory/ABF substrate bottleneck commentary from the August 11, 2026 OCP APAC Summit remarks
weakens_if: TSMC management states the memory/ABF constraint has eased or that CoWoS-adjacent supply chain pressure is resolving faster than expected

event: Micron's fiscal Q4 2026 earnings call
supports_if: Micron reiterates or raises HBM4 shipment and pricing commitments and confirms calendar-2026 HBM supply remains fully committed under long-term agreements
weakens_if: Micron reports softening HBM order commitments, delayed HBM4 ramp, or a pullback in guided gross margin tied to memory pricing

event: SK Hynix's Q3 2026 earnings call
supports_if: SK Hynix reiterates its shortage-through-2030 outlook, continues HBM4 ramp on schedule, and maintains or raises 2026 capital expenditure guidance
weakens_if: SK Hynix walks back its shortage timeline, signals HBM4 demand softening, or scales back capital expenditure guidance

event: Samsung Electronics' Q3 2026 earnings call
supports_if: Samsung reports progress toward its ~250,000 wafers/month HBM capacity target and confirms HBM4 yield and qualification progress with major customers
weakens_if: Samsung reports HBM4 yield problems, delayed qualification, or falls materially short of its stated capacity ramp target

event: Further industry tracking (TrendForce, Counterpoint, SemiAnalysis) of CXMT's HBM wafer-start ramp and global DRAM/HBM supply-demand balance
supports_if: CXMT's HBM ramp remains behind SemiAnalysis-cited projections and overall market trackers continue to show a supply deficit persisting toward 2028-2030
weakens_if: CXMT's HBM output scales faster than projected, or trackers show the supply-demand gap narrowing materially ahead of the 2027-2028 window some analysts already flag
source_to_monitor: TrendForce, Counterpoint Research, and SemiAnalysis published research

event: Siemens Energy's Q4 FY2026 earnings call
supports_if: Grid Technologies order backlog and margin guidance continue rising and lead times are reiterated or extended
weakens_if: Grid Technologies order growth decelerates, backlog growth stalls, or margin guidance is cut

event: GE Vernova's Q3 2026 earnings call
supports_if: Electrification segment orders and equipment backlog continue growing at a comparable or faster pace than Q2 2026
weakens_if: Electrification orders or backlog growth decelerates materially, or book-to-bill falls toward 1.0

event: Progress updates on Hitachi Energy's South Boston, Virginia plant and other announced US transformer-capacity expansions
supports_if: Construction proceeds on the announced ~2028-2029 production timeline with no reported delays
weakens_if: Construction timelines slip, or announced capacity investment is scaled back
source_to_monitor: Hitachi Energy newsroom (hitachienergy.com) and trade press (Utility Dive, Manufacturing Dive)

event: Next industry tracking (Wood Mackenzie or equivalent) of US data-center electrical-equipment lead times and 2026-2027 delay/cancellation rates
supports_if: Lead times remain at or near current multi-year levels and the reported delay/cancellation share of planned data-center capacity stays in or above the 30-50% range
weakens_if: Lead times shorten materially or the reported delay/cancellation share falls well below current levels
source_to_monitor: Wood Mackenzie published research and trade press (Data Center Knowledge, Utility Dive)

event: ICSG's next Copper Market Forecast update
supports_if: The forecast reverts to or confirms a deficit for 2026-2027
weakens_if: The forecast maintains or widens the surplus projected in April 2026

event: Freeport-McMoRan's Q3 2026 earnings call
supports_if: Management reiterates strong AI/data-center-linked copper demand commentary and raises capex or production guidance
weakens_if: Demand commentary softens materially or capital-expenditure guidance is cut

event: US copper tariff decision
supports_if: Tariffs are imposed, sustaining the US stockpiling squeeze and price premium
weakens_if: Tariff plans are dropped or delayed, releasing COMEX inventory back toward global markets
source_to_monitor: White House / USTR announcements, trade press (Reuters, Bloomberg)

event: DRC concentrate export ban implementation and enforcement outcome
supports_if: The ban is enforced and sustained, forcing smelters to compete harder for constrained concentrate supply
weakens_if: The ban is reversed, eased, or shown to be widely evaded or of limited effect
source_to_monitor: Reuters, DRC Ministry of Mines, Ivanhoe Mines and other DRC-exposed miners' disclosures

event: Updated Wood Mackenzie or S&P Global copper supply-demand balance report
supports_if: Deficit projections widen or are reaffirmed for 2027 and beyond
weakens_if: Projections narrow materially toward balance

event: Coherent Corp's Q1 FY2027 earnings call
supports_if: Management reiterates capacity constraints, raises guidance, and confirms InP fab expansion remains fully subscribed
weakens_if: Management signals easing lead times, decelerating bookings, or a pause in capacity expansion plans

event: Lumentum's Q1 FY2027 earnings call
supports_if: Management confirms the guided ~130% YoY growth, reiterates capacity-constrained commentary, and reports continued OCS/CPO backlog growth
weakens_if: Guidance is missed or management signals softening demand or easing component constraints

event: Hyperscaler Q4 2026 and Q1 2027 capital-expenditure guidance (Google, Meta, Microsoft, Amazon)
supports_if: Capex guidance continues growing at or near 2026's pace, sustaining demand pressure on optical-networking capacity
weakens_if: Capex guidance decelerates materially toward the 30-50% range analysts flag as the oversupply trigger

event: Updated TrendForce or McKinsey optical-transceiver supply-demand balance research
supports_if: Shortfall estimates are reaffirmed or widened for 2027
weakens_if: Shortfall estimates narrow materially or forecasters flag emerging oversupply risk
source_to_monitor: TrendForce press center (trendforce.com/presscenter) and McKinsey Technology, Media & Telecommunications insights

event: Disclosure of actual terms or early deliveries under Nvidia's March 2026 purchase commitments with Coherent and Lumentum
supports_if: Disclosed volumes confirm a large, multi-year capacity lock-in consistent with reported lead-time extensions for other buyers
weakens_if: Disclosed terms turn out to be smaller or less exclusive than initial coverage suggested
source_to_monitor: Nvidia Newsroom (nvidianews.nvidia.com), Coherent and Lumentum SEC filings

event: Air Products' fiscal Q4 2026 earnings call
supports_if: Management again cites helium as a margin headwind and reiterates elevated pricing/dislocation costs tied to the Middle East disruption
weakens_if: Management reports helium turning into a net tailwind or normalized costs

event: Linde's Q3 2026 earnings call
supports_if: Management maintains or pushes out its 'early 2027' helium normalization guidance and reports continued electronics backlog growth
weakens_if: Management pulls forward its normalization timeline or reports decelerating electronics backlog growth

event: Continued Strait of Hormuz transit data
supports_if: Daily transits remain far below the roughly 85/day pre-conflict baseline
weakens_if: Transits recover materially toward pre-conflict levels
source_to_monitor: Lloyd's List Intelligence and shipping-data trackers

event: QatarEnergy Ras Laffan repair-progress disclosure
supports_if: QatarEnergy reports repairs still years from completion or force majeure remains in effect
weakens_if: QatarEnergy lifts force majeure and confirms near-full capacity restoration
source_to_monitor: QatarEnergy official channels and trade press (Reuters, Bloomberg, Argus Media)

event: TSMC, Samsung and SK Hynix commentary on helium inventory buffers
supports_if: Fabs report drawing down buffer inventory further or facing rationing
weakens_if: Fabs report buffers fully replenished with no operational impact
source_to_monitor: TSMC, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix investor relations

event: FERC ruling on PJM's ER26-3380 IRAS/BYONC filing
expected_window: Q4 2026 (around or after PJM's requested October 12, 2026 effective date)
supports_if: FERC approves the IRAS framework substantially as filed, with the BYONC-linked curtailment priority intact
weakens_if: FERC rejects, materially delays, or requires the framework be made voluntary

event: Other RTOs' (MISO, SPP, ISO-NE, NYISO, CAISO) compliance filings under FERC's RM26-4 show-cause order
supports_if: Multiple RTOs adopt comparable curtailment-priority or BYONC-style frameworks, confirming a national pattern rather than a PJM-only anomaly
weakens_if: Other RTOs adopt materially weaker or no comparable rules, enabling large-load migration away from PJM

event: PJM's next Base Residual Auction results
supports_if: The reliability shortfall persists or widens and clearing prices remain at or above the 2027/2028 record
weakens_if: The shortfall closes and clearing prices decline materially

event: GE Vernova, Siemens Energy and Mitsubishi Power quarterly earnings calls
supports_if: Gas-turbine backlogs continue growing and lead times remain at or beyond 2029-2031
weakens_if: Backlog growth stalls or lead times shorten materially

event: PJM Large Load Registry data on new large-load interconnection requests and BYONC uptake
supports_if: Registry shows a high volume of large-load requests without secured BYONC, confirming binding curtailment exposure
weakens_if: Most new large loads register with BYONC already secured via contracts or purchased capacity, reducing curtailment exposure
source_to_monitor: PJM Large Load Registry / PJM Inside Lines

event: Associated Builders and Contractors' next annual construction workforce shortage report
supports_if: The reported net-new-worker need for 2027, and specifically for electrical/mechanical trades, stays elevated or rises
weakens_if: The reported shortfall narrows materially or ABC reports the gap closing
source_to_monitor: Associated Builders and Contractors (abc.org) / GlobeNewswire releases

event: EMCOR Group, Comfort Systems USA and Quanta Services Q3 2026 earnings calls
supports_if: Backlog and electrical/mechanical segment revenue continue growing at or near Q2 2026's pace and management continues citing labor availability as a constraint
weakens_if: Backlog growth decelerates sharply or management no longer cites labor as a binding constraint

event: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook / Employment Projections update for electricians
supports_if: Projected annual openings or growth rate for electricians rises from the current ~9%/72,700-per-year estimate
weakens_if: Projected growth or openings estimate falls, signaling the gap is expected to close faster

event: Reported graduate/hiring outcomes from Microsoft-NABTU and Meta's Workforce Academy training programs
supports_if: Programs report modest graduate numbers relative to the multi-hundred-thousand-worker shortfall, or hyperscalers announce further training investment
weakens_if: Programs report graduate numbers that materially close the shortfall or the shortage is reported easing

event: Industry tracking of AI data-center delay/cancellation rates attributed to labor availability
supports_if: Trackers (e.g., Turner & Townsend, Wood Mackenzie, JLL) report labor availability as a leading or growing cause of project delay
weakens_if: Labor-attributed delay share falls or other causes (power, permitting) dominate instead
source_to_monitor: Turner & Townsend, Wood Mackenzie, JLL published research and trade press

event: Governor Hochul's decision on the Responsible Data Center Development Act (S10642/A11560)
supports_if: She signs it, codifying a second, broader (20 MW) statewide moratorium layer on top of Executive Order 62
weakens_if: She vetoes it or lets it lapse without signing
source_to_monitor: New York State Senate/Assembly bill tracker; Governor's office announcements

event: Conclusion of the Texas PUC/ERCOT data-center interconnection audit
supports_if: A material share of the ~200 GW/250-300 projects under review is denied or further delayed
weakens_if: Most projects are cleared and interconnection processing resumes at pre-audit pace
source_to_monitor: Texas PUC and ERCOT public filings; trade press (Utility Dive, Texas Tribune)

event: Further court rulings on challenged local/state data-center moratoria beyond Imperial County
supports_if: Courts generally uphold moratoria against legal challenge
weakens_if: More courts strike down moratoria on procedural or substantive grounds, as in Imperial County
source_to_monitor: State court dockets; local and legal trade press

event: Ohio ballot campaign's renewed signature drive for a future statewide vote on banning data centers
supports_if: Organizers qualify the initiative for a future ballot
weakens_if: The campaign is abandoned or fails to gather sufficient signatures again
source_to_monitor: Ohio Secretary of State filings; Ohio Capital Journal

event: Next comprehensive tally of blocked/delayed data-center capital and local moratoria count
supports_if: Blocked/delayed capital and moratoria count continue climbing at a similar or faster pace
weakens_if: Growth in blocked capital or new moratoria plateaus or reverses
source_to_monitor: Data Center Watch, MultiState published research

event: China's decision on the November 10, 2026 rare-earth export-control suspension deadline
supports_if: China narrows license approvals, imposes new company-specific blacklist actions, or lets controls on erbium and the other four elements resume
weakens_if: China extends the full suspension or formally lifts controls with no new restrictions
source_to_monitor: MOFCOM/GACC announcements; trade press (Reuters, Bloomberg, Financial Times)

event: GE Vernova, Siemens Energy and Mitsubishi Power Q4 2026/Q1 2027 earnings calls
supports_if: Management cites yttrium/rare-earth input costs or availability as a turbine-delivery risk factor
weakens_if: Management reports no material rare-earth-related cost or delivery impact

event: MP Materials, Lynas and USA Rare Earth reported progress on heavy-rare-earth (yttrium/erbium) separation capacity
supports_if: Reported capacity and output remain well below stated nameplate targets or timelines slip
weakens_if: Capacity ramps materially ahead of schedule toward or beyond stated nameplate targets
source_to_monitor: Company investor relations and SEC filings

event: Updated trade/customs data on yttrium and erbium export volumes to non-China markets
supports_if: Export volumes remain depressed or decline further versus pre-2025-restriction baselines
weakens_if: Export volumes recover materially toward pre-restriction levels
source_to_monitor: China customs data via trade press and industry trackers

event: Ex-China vs. China-domestic rare-earth price spread tracking
supports_if: The spread stays wide or widens further, indicating persistent scarcity pricing outside China
weakens_if: The spread narrows materially, indicating supply access is normalizing
source_to_monitor: Rare-earth market pricing trackers and industry research

event: Western Digital fiscal Q1 FY2027 earnings call
supports_if: Management reiterates sold-out capacity, growing long-term agreement coverage into 2028+, and continued Cloud-segment revenue concentration
weakens_if: Management reports easing backlog, shortening lead times, or a pullback in hyperscaler orders

event: Seagate Technology fiscal Q1 FY2027 earnings call
supports_if: Nearline exabyte growth and 2028 capacity allocation continue, and HAMR penetration tracks toward the 70% June 2027 target
weakens_if: Nearline growth decelerates sharply or HAMR ramp slips behind schedule

event: TrendForce Q4 2026 NAND/DRAM contract price forecast
supports_if: Forecast reiterates or accelerates price increases, or confirms industry-wide sold-out capacity into 2027
weakens_if: Forecast shows price growth flattening or turning negative

event: Kioxia Holdings / SanDisk fiscal Q2 FY2027 results and Japan investment progress update
supports_if: Government subsidy approval and fab construction proceed on the disclosed 2032 timeline with continued strong NAND ASP growth
weakens_if: Investment is scaled back, delayed, or subsidy approval is denied

event: Pure Storage and NetApp next quarterly earnings calls
supports_if: Management continues to cite AI-driven demand outpacing supply and extended component lead times
weakens_if: Management reports component constraints easing or lead times normalizing

event: Commerce Department (BIS) publishes the drafted remote-access rule in the Federal Register
supports_if: A rule is published covering Thailand/Singapore-style GPU rental with clear licensing requirements
weakens_if: The rule is delayed indefinitely or narrowed to exclude cloud/rental access

event: Senate floor vote or committee markup on S. 3519 (Remote Access Security Act)
supports_if: The bill advances out of committee or receives a floor vote
weakens_if: The bill remains stalled in committee with no scheduled action

event: Nvidia's fiscal Q3 2027 earnings call commentary on China revenue assumptions and export-control risk
supports_if: Nvidia continues to assume zero China data-center revenue and cites regulatory uncertainty around remote access
weakens_if: Nvidia signals resuming China compute revenue or discloses no material remote-access enforcement risk

event: Further disclosed large-scale GPU rental deals or BIS/Commerce enforcement actions against third-country data-center operators
supports_if: New deals or enforcement actions are reported, confirming the loophole remains active and contested
weakens_if: No new deals surface and no enforcement occurs, suggesting the issue has quietly stalled
source_to_monitor: trade press (Tom's Hardware, The Register, SemiAnalysis)

event: Updated analyst tracking (Bernstein, TrendForce, SemiAnalysis or equivalent) of Huawei/domestic Chinese AI chip market share
supports_if: Domestic share continues rising toward or beyond 90%, reducing reliance on remote Nvidia access
weakens_if: Domestic share stalls or declines, keeping Chinese demand for remote Nvidia access elevated
